lines.text: Before Goddess Parvati was born…
there was Sati.
And her birth was destined to change the life of Lord Shiva forever.
Daksha Prajapati, the son of Brahma, desired to have the divine Goddess Shakti as his daughter.
He performed intense penance…
praying for the Goddess to bless his family.
Pleased by his devotion, the divine Mother appeared before him.
Daksha bowed and requested her to be born as his daughter…
so that she could become the wife of Lord Shiva.
The Goddess accepted his wish…
but gave him a warning.
She told Daksha that if he ever disrespected her…
or forgot her divine nature…
she would abandon that body and return to her eternal form.
Soon, the Goddess was born into Daksha's family…
as Sati, the daughter of Daksha and Asikni.
Her birth brought joy to the family…
but her destiny was far greater than anyone could imagine.
From childhood, Sati felt a deep connection with Lord Shiva…
the supreme yogi who lived beyond worldly desires.
Her heart was devoted to him alone.
But her father, Daksha, would one day develop a deep hatred toward Shiva.
And the very daughter he had prayed for…
would become the reason for a conflict that shook the heavens.
This was the beginning of Sati's story…
a story of divine love, devotion, pride, and tragedy.
In the next episode…
Sati begins her penance to win Lord Shiva as her husband.
